tool_use_result.originalFile: export const offset = (page, perPage) => page * perPage;

content.text:
I fixed an off-by-one in `src/offset.js`, and all 4 tests pass now.

**Bug:** The tests number pages from 1 (page 1 is the newest five), but `offset` computed `page * perPage`. That made page 1 start at the sixth issue and return `[7, 6, 5, 4, 3]` instead of `[12, 11, 10, 9, 8]`. Page 3 started past the end of the list and came back empty instead of `[2, 1]`.

**Fix:** `offset` is now `(page - 1) * perPage`. `src/page.js` is the only file that calls it, so nothing else is affected.
